description: This PHP class defines a formatter that outputs an employee's full name based on an employee number, utilizing employee services via traits.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeName
classes.description: A class implementing ValueFormatter to format values as employees' full names based on employee number, using injected employee service trait.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee corresponding to the given employee number entity value, or null if not found.
